'''Hollow trees''' are members-only trees that grow in the [[Haunted Woods]] and the [[The Hollows|Hollows]] areas of [[Morytania]], east of [[Canifis]]. [[Woodcutting]] level 45 is required to cut them. When chopped, hollow trees will either give 82.5 experience, or [[bark]] and 275 experience, granting 9.74 or 32.45 [[equipment experience]] respectively. The former is much more common.
